extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) 'species' had space and case variants (' Adelie', 'Adelie ') which were normalized to 'Adelie'; (2) 'island' had a lowercase variant ('biscoe') which was normalized to 'Biscoe'; (3) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas (e.g., '3,450'), which was converted to numeric values. All values were within the allowed range (2500–6500 grams). The average body mass is 3,767.24 g for Adelie, 3,726.79 g for Chinstrap, and 4,895.83 g for Gentoo penguins.
